question: What kind of out-of-domain data?
title: Predicting Annotation Difficulty to Improve Task Routing and Model Performance for Biomedical Information Extraction
answer_rationale: The 'universal' encoder is trained on out-of-domain data to capture general semantics, which complements task-specific encoders in specialized domains, as demonstrated in biomedical information extraction tasks. This is explicitly stated in Text 1 and supported by Text 5, which describes the use of universal sentence encoders trained on out-of-domain data.
